shared_elements: animal figure shown in profile in shallow relief
incised linear/abstract markings on a flat stone face
curved arc line spanning the upper part of the field
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow relief carving that includes at least one profile animal form (an isolated quadruped/reptilian creature in A, animal-shaped signs among the sign rows in B) plus abstract incised lines, but this is about as generic as carved imagery gets. A shows a single large, sparse creature with a few free-standing angular marks on an unruled surface, whereas B is densely organised into a lunette with a winged disc over a row of standing worshipping figures above many ruled horizontal registers of small repeated signs — an entirely different compositional scheme and depictive convention.
